range_missing_reason: DERIVED from one local height with no interval: 1 + 0.5h with h = 0.93 m. FAO-56 gives no interval for the exponent. For context only, the spread of the campaign means of h (0.84-1.06 m) would give 1.42-1.53; that is not an uncertainty interval of this value.

note: Decision scope (D232, D233; supersedes signed D204 T4/T5 currently on origin/main superseding previous 1.0 m / 1.5 to sensitivity). Written on 2026-11-15 by an AI session to follow D232 and D233 of issue #77 (https://github.com/gbarbozamar/field-shift-rotation-twin/issues/77#issuecomment-6893254289), taken by the orchestrating AI session under the delegation of D161. Following executive sign-off, 1.5 becomes the sensitivity together with h = 1.0 m. Load one exponent for wheat only: both records share id and scope. WHAT IS TRANSFERRED: the formula, FAO-56 Eq. 76, read as an image: fc = ((Kcb - Kc min) / (Kc max - Kc min))^(1 + 0.5h); verbatim text to compare: «The '1+0.5h' exponent in the equation represents the effect of plant height on shading the soil surface»; symbols: «h mean plant height [m].» The source also says: «This equation should be used with caution and validated from field observations.» WHAT IS LOCAL: h = 0.93 m, the draft crop_height.wheat.json of this folder (national cultivar evaluation, La Estanzuela, sowing period 1, intermediate cycle, 16 campaigns 2010-2025, D233 selection; the height includes the awns). WHAT IS CHOSEN: one height, hence one exponent, for the whole cycle (the limit declared in D204); EP3 reads one exponent per crop, the same on every crop day. ARITHMETIC: 1 + 0.5 x 0.93 = 1.465. This record must change if the signed height changes.
